cities.name: Barcelona
cities.local_food_tip: Tapas, tortilla, veggie paella, patatas bravas, pastries and lots of Mediterranean vegetarian-friendly dishes.
cities.full_day:
Morning: ⛪ Sagrada Família (Exterior): Gaudí’s dreamlike basilica with surreal towers. → 🌴 Passeig de Gràcia: Modernist buildings and elegant boulevard vibes. → 🏠 Casa Batlló (Exterior): Vibrant and wavy Gaudí façade. → ☕ Eixample Café. 

Afternoon: 🏰 Gothic Quarter: Medieval alleys and tiny plazas. → 🌿 Parc de la Ciutadella: Green paths, lake and palm trees. → 🍽️ Tapas Lunch: Veggie paella, tortilla, patatas bravas. → 🎨 El Born Galleries.

Sunset: 🌅 Barceloneta Beach: Soft golden-hour light.

Night: 🌃 Port Vell Marina: Gelato stands, calm walkway, waterfront reflections.
public_transport_tips: 🚇 Metro is the fastest way to move across the city.
🚌 Buses are great for short central distances.
📱 Use TMB App for live schedules.

city_events.name: La Mercè Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 Huge cultural festival with street shows, art and performances.

city_events.name: Sant Jordi
city_events.description: 📚 Book & flower celebration across the entire city.

cities.name: Bilbao
cities.local_food_tip: Bilbao is famous for pintxos — including many vegetarian options like tortilla, peppers, salads and bread-based bites.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🎨 Guggenheim Museum (Exterior): Metallic curves + outdoor sculptures. → 🐶 Puppy Sculpture: Giant flower-covered dog. → 🌊 Nervión Riverside Walk. → ☕ Zubizuri Bridge Café. 

Afternoon: 🏙️ Casco Viejo (Old Town): Narrow colorful streets. → 🏛️ Plaza Nueva: Arcaded square. → 🍽️ Basque Lunch: Veggie pintxos, tortilla, salads. → 🌿 Doña Casilda Park.

Sunset: 🌅 Artxanda Hill Viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Riverside lights + ice cream walk.
public_transport_tips: 🚇 Bilbao Metro is fast and very clean.
🚶 Many attractions are walkable along the river.
📱 Use Bilbobus app for easy navigation.

city_events.name: Aste Nagusia
city_events.description: 🎉 Week-long cultural celebration with parades, shows and concerts.

cities.name: Córdoba
cities.local_food_tip: Try salmorejo (veg-friendly), tortilla, grilled veggies and fresh Andalusian salads.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🕌 Mezquita Cathedral (Exterior): Famous arches + golden doors. → 🌉 Roman Bridge Walk: Calm riverside. → 🏛️ Calahorra Tower (Exterior). → ☕ Jewish Quarter Café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Judería: Flower-filled alleys. → 🌺 Calleja de las Flores: Iconic postcard spot. → 🍽️ Mediterranean Lunch: Salmorejo, tortilla, salads. → 🌿 Alcázar Gardens exterior paths.

Sunset: 🌅 Guadalquivir riverside.

Night: 🌃 Dessert walk through softly lit alleys.
public_transport_tips: 🚶 Old town is best explored on foot.
🚌 Bus network covers all districts easily.
🚖 Taxis are cheap for short distances.

city_events.name: Fiesta de los Patios
city_events.description: 🌺 Famous festival celebrating Córdoba’s decorated courtyards.

cities.name: Granada
cities.local_food_tip: Couscous, veggie tajines, tortilla, patatas bravas and Moorish-Andalusian pastries.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Alhambra (Exterior areas): Towers, gardens and forest paths. → 🌿 Alhambra Forest Walk. → 🕍 Plaza Nueva. → ☕ Darro River Café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Albaicín: White alleys and viewpoints. → 🌄 Mirador de San Nicolás: Alhambra + mountains. → 🍽️ Moorish Lunch: Veg tajine, couscous, salads. → 🎨 Paseo de los Tristes.

Sunset: 🌅 San Miguel Alto viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Old Town dessert walk.
public_transport_tips: 🚶 Old town is walkable but steep in parts.
🚖 Use taxis for viewpoints like San Miguel Alto.

city_events.name: Fiestas del Corpus
city_events.description: 🎉 Traditional celebrations with parades and cultural events.

cities.name: Málaga
cities.local_food_tip: Veggie paella, tortilla española, patatas bravas, grilled veggies and Mediterranean salads — light, coastal and fresh.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Alcazaba (Exterior): Moorish fortress walls + palm terraces. → 🏛️ Roman Theatre: Ancient stone rows beneath the fortress. → 🎨 Picasso Museum (Exterior): Artistic quarter vibes. → ☕ Old Town Café.

Afternoon: 🌿 Parque de Málaga: Tropical shades and fountains. → 🌊 Port of Málaga (Muelle Uno): Shops, sea breeze, modern waterfront. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veggie paella, tortilla, salads. → 🎨 Pompidou Málaga (Exterior).

Sunset: 🌅 La Malagueta Beach: Warm Mediterranean golden hour.

Night: 🌃 Soho Street-Art District: Murals, dessert cafés, ice cream.

city_events.name: Feria de Málaga
city_events.description: 🎉 Week-long summer celebration with music, colors and parades.

cities.name: Palma de Mallorca
cities.local_food_tip: Paella, tumbet (Mallorcan veggie dish), fresh bread with tomato, salads and ensaimada pastries.
cities.full_day:
Morning: ⛪ Palma Cathedral (Exterior): Majestic sandstone walls above the sea. → 🌊 Parc de la Mar: Lakeside palm-lined promenade. → 🏛️ Almudaina Palace (Exterior). → ☕ Old Town Café.

Afternoon: 🏘️ Palma Old Town: Narrow alleys, patios, artisan shops. → 🌿 Passeig del Born: Shaded boulevard with fountains. → 🍽️ Mallorcan Lunch: Veggie paella, tumbet, salads. → 🎨 Es Baluard (Exterior).

Sunset: 🌅 Portixol Promenade: Calm golden-hour seaside.

Night: 🌃 Cathedral waterfront walk: Gelato stands + peaceful night views.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 EMT buses cover all of Palma well.
🚶 Old Town is best explored on foot.
🚲 Rent a bike for the promenade.
📱 Use EMT Palma app for live info.

city_events.name: Sant Sebastià
city_events.description: 🎸 Live music festival and city-wide celebration.

cities.name: Sevilla
cities.local_food_tip: Gazpacho, veggie tapas, tortilla, patatas bravas and light Andalusian Mediterranean dishes.
cities.full_day:
Morning: ⛪ Seville Cathedral (Exterior): Enormous Gothic masterpiece. → 🗼 La Giralda (Exterior): Moorish–Renaissance tower views. → 🏛️ Archivo de Indias (Exterior). → ☕ Santa Cruz Café.

Afternoon: 🌿 María Luisa Park: Palms, fountains, tiled benches. → 🏰 Plaza de España: Iconic semicircular palace + canal. → 🍽️ Andalusian Lunch: Veg tapas, gazpacho, tortilla. → 🌉 Guadalquivir Riverside Walk.

Sunset: 🌅 Triana Riverside.

Night: 🌃 Old-town dessert walk: Ice cream, pastries, quieter alleys.
public_transport_tips: 🚈 Tram runs through the central avenues.

city_events.name: Feria de Abril
city_events.description: 🎉 City-wide celebration with traditional music, dancing and lights.

cities.name: Valencia
cities.local_food_tip: Paella Valenciana (veg versions available), patatas bravas, tortilla, salads and horchata pastries.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ City of Arts & Sciences (Exterior): Sci-fi architecture + water reflections. → 🌿 Turia River Park: Green paths and bridges. → 🏰 Torres de Serranos (Exterior). → ☕ Old-town café.

Afternoon: 🏘️ El Carmen: Colorful alleys, murals. → ⛪ Cathedral (Exterior). → 🍽️ Local Lunch: Veg paella, tortilla, salads. → 🌿 Plaza de la Virgen.

Sunset: 🌅 Malvarrosa Beach.

Night: 🌃 Marina waterfront: Ice cream, smoothies, calm seaside walk.
public_transport_tips: 🚲 Turia Park is perfect for biking.

city_events.name: Las Fallas
city_events.description: 🔥 Famous festival with sculptures, lights and street celebrations.

cities.name: Alicante
cities.local_food_tip: Alicante je poznat po arrozu (rižotima), ali postoji i mnogo veg opcija — veggie paella, tortilla, salate i mediteranski obroci.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Santa Bárbara Castle (Exterior Viewpoints): Fortress on a hill with amazing sea views. → 🌊 Postiguet Beach Walk: Soft sand + clear water. → ☕ Beachfront Café Break. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Barrio de Santa Cruz: Colorful houses and narrow alleys. → 🏛️ Esplanada d’Espanya: Palm-lined walkway with marble mosaic. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg paella, salads, tortilla. → 🌿 Mount Benacantil lower paths.

Sunset: 🌅 Serra Grossa Viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Esplanade night walk: Gelato, crepes, breezy seaside lights.

ideas: 🍁 Warm tones in Santa Cruz alleys

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Bus network covers the port area.

city_events.name: Hogueras de San Juan
city_events.description: 🔥 Sculptures, lights and summer celebrations by the sea.

cities.name: Gran Canaria
cities.local_food_tip: Papas arrugadas, mojo sauces, veggie stews, salads and tropical fruits — tipično kanarsko i veoma lagano.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏖️ Las Canteras Beach Walk: Golden sand + clear waves. → 🌊 Alfredo Kraus Auditorium (Exterior). → ☕ Beachfront café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Vegueta Old Town: Colonial streets. → 🏛️ Santa Ana Cathedral (Exterior). → 🍽️ Canarian Lunch: Papas arrugadas, salads, tortilla. → 🎨 Casa de Colón (Exterior).

Sunset: 🌅 Maspalomas Dunes (Viewpoint area).

Night: 🌃 Meloneras Promenade: Ice cream, waffles, seaside breeze.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 Buses are reliable and connect the entire island.
🚗 Renting a car helpful for viewpoints.

city_events.name: Carnaval de Las Palmas
city_events.description: 🎭 Massive island carnival with costumes and music.

cities.name: Ibiza
cities.local_food_tip: Veggie paella, salads, tortilla, Mediterranean bowls — čisto, lagano i osvežavajuće.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏖️ Talamanca Beach: Calm turquoise water. → 🌿 Sa Punta Coastal Walk. → 🏛️ Dalt Vila Lower Streets (Exterior). → ☕ Marina Café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ Ibiza Old Town: Colorful doors, art shops. → 🌿 Parc de la Paz. → 🍽️ Light Mediterranean Lunch: Veg paella, salads, grilled veggies. → 🎨 Marina Art Stands.

Sunset: 🌅 Es Vedrà Viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Marina promenade: Gelato, crepes, soft lights.
public_transport_tips: 🚶 Old town is walkable but steep.

city_events.name: Medieval Fair Ibiza
city_events.description: 🏰 Old-town themed fair with crafts and shows.

cities.name: Tenerife
cities.local_food_tip: Papas arrugadas with mojo, veggie stews, salads and fresh tropical fruits — jednostavno i ukusno.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌋 Teide National Park (Exterior viewpoints): Lava fields + craters. → 🏜️ Roques de García (photo). → 🌿 Teide Scenic Roads. → ☕ Vilaflor mountain café. 

Afternoon: 🏘️ La Orotava: Historic balconies, calm plazas. → 🌿 Jardines Victoria. → 🍽️ Canarian Lunch: Papas arrugadas, salads, veggie stews. → 🎨 Casa de los Balcones (Exterior).

Sunset: 🌅 Playa de Benijo Viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Puerto de la Cruz promenade: Ice cream, waffles, ocean breeze.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 TITSA buses cover the whole island.

city_events.name: Carnaval de Santa Cruz
city_events.description: 🎉 One of the biggest carnivals in the world.
